data.desc: The Children's Place is one of the only pure-play children's specialty retailers in North America with an omni-channel presence. Its global retail and wholesale network includes two digital storefronts, 514 stores in North America, wholesale marketplaces and distribution in 13 countries through ten international franchise and wholesale partners. The Children's Place designs, contracts to manufacture, and sells fashionable, high-quality, head-to-toe outfits predominantly at value prices, primarily under its proprietary brands: 'The Children's Place' and 'Gymboree'. For more information, visit: www.childrensplace.com and www.gymboree.com .
